bio.text: Mike McGuire has represented California's 2nd State Senate District since December 2014 and is the Democratic candidate for California's 1st Congressional District in 2026.
He was elected Senate president pro tempore on February 5, 2024.
Born in Healdsburg in 1979, he earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Sonoma State University in 2002 and worked in radio and television.
He was elected to the Healdsburg School Board at 19, the Healdsburg City Council in 2004, and the Sonoma County Board of Supervisors in 2010.
